zh.summary: 识别叙事传播与异常扩散，为团队提供预警和传播路径分析。
zh.judgment: 潜在价值在预警后能做什么；误报、提前量和响应效果决定采购价值。
zh.replaces: 公关与安全团队手动查关键词、拼传播链并整理简报。
zh.product: 官网提供叙事预警、网络映射、受众行为分类与生成模型品牌描述监测。它面向组织的信息判断和响应工作；覆盖范围与准确度属于公司声明，未实测。
zh.customer: 官网列出传播、法务、政府事务、领导与安全团队。采购价值可能来自危机处置和协调效率；实际预算方、合同金额和客户数量未在本次资料中确认。
zh.workflow: 可评估的流程是发现信号、追溯来源与传播路径、判断影响、分派负责人和跟踪结果。应保留证据与不确定性，让分析师能复核预警依据，而不只收到自动摘要。
zh.business_model: 定价页确认采用定制方案，按监测范围、洞察深度、交付方式与支持协作共同制定，没有公开单价。平台数据获取、客户配置与分析师交付可能形成较高成本，需要看配置复用和续约是否覆盖持续服务。
zh.traction: 产品目录与融资新闻能确认公司定位，不能证明预警更早、更准或客户已经续约。缺少独立准确率、误报率、客户节省时间与付费规模数据。
zh.moat: 跨平台传播图谱和经复核的历史事件标签可能形成累积优势。若主要能力是通用摘要与关键词监测，容易被现有工具吸收；数据可持续获取与复核质量更重要。
zh.funding_read: 10 月 8 日报道一笔 700 万美元种子融资。可研究的下一里程碑是重复采购与可比事件的预警质量；这笔资金本身不能证明客户愿意长期购买。
zh.risks: 缺失数据可能改变传播判断，误报可能消耗响应资源。行为分类也需要人工复核；模型对品牌的描述变化未必意味着有组织操纵，不能把相关性当作因果。
zh.takeaway: 把监测变成可追溯的判断与响应链条。先定义谁收到预警、怎样复核、何时行动及如何回看结果，再扩大信号覆盖。
zh.watch_next: 观察可比事件的预警提前量、误报率、证据复核时间、团队行动比例和合同续约。对照传统工作流才能判断预测与自动化是否减少实际损失。

en.summary: Narrative intelligence for detecting emerging stories and tracing amplification.
en.judgment: Value depends on action after an alert; false alarms, lead time and response outcomes determine procurement value.
en.replaces: Manual keyword checks, reconstruction of amplification chains and analyst briefs.
en.product: The site lists narrative alerts, network mapping, audience behavior classification and monitoring of how generative models describe brands. Coverage and accuracy are company claims, not independently tested here.
en.customer: The site identifies communications, legal, government-affairs, leadership and security teams. Crisis response and coordination are plausible buying motives. Actual budget owners, contract values and customer counts were not established.
en.workflow: Assess a chain from signal detection through source review, impact assessment, ownership and outcome tracking. Evidence and uncertainty should remain available for analysts to challenge an alert rather than receiving only a summary.
en.business_model: The price page confirms tailored plans based on monitoring scope, insight depth, delivery and support, without public unit prices. Data access, configuration and analyst work may be costly; reuse and renewal must cover continuing service.
en.traction: Product materials and financing reports establish positioning without proving earlier warnings, higher accuracy or renewals. Independent false-alarm rates, time savings and payment scale were not available here.
en.moat: Cross-platform propagation graphs and reviewed historical event labels could accumulate advantages. Generic summaries and keyword monitoring are easier for incumbents to absorb. Sustainable data access and review quality matter more.
en.funding_read: An October 8 report records a $7 million seed round. Repeat procurement and comparable-event alert quality are useful milestones. The financing alone does not establish durable customer demand.
en.risks: Missing data can distort propagation analysis and false alarms can consume response resources. Behavioral labels require review. Changes in model descriptions do not by themselves establish coordinated manipulation.
en.takeaway: Turn monitoring into a traceable judgment and response process. Define alert recipients, review, action and outcome assessment before broadening signal coverage.
en.watch_next: Watch warning lead time, false alarms, review effort, action rates and renewals. Comparable manual workflows help establish whether forecasting and automation reduce actual losses.
